calls.statement:
WITH fv AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) nver
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS first_versions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
  SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from <> join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_valid_from_ne_join,
  SUM(CASE WHEN join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_fy2526,
  SUM(CASE WHEN join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_cal2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN nver>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_version,
  SUM(CASE WHEN home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_store,
  MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date),
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id, join_date HAVING COUNT(*)>1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT valid_from)<COUNT(*))) dupver,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date)>1)) multi_join
FROM fv WHERE rn=1

calls.statement:
WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn
  FROM dim_member
), cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id AS cur_home FROM dim_member WHERE is_current
), s AS (
  SELECT store_id, ANY_VALUE(store_name) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS store_name, ANY_VALUE(region) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS region,
         MIN(open_date) od, MAX(close_date) cd, COUNT(*) vers
  FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT fv.home_store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.od, s.cd, s.vers, COUNT(*) AS new_members,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cur.cur_home<>fv.home_store_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differs_now
FROM fv JOIN cur USING (member_id) LEFT JOIN s ON s.store_id=fv.home_store_id
WHERE fv.rn=1 AND fv.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
